welcome_body: Create your character and choose from 5 unique classes. Each class has its own skill tree, passives and playstyle.
fight_body: Open the Map and start a combat. Use your skills, drink potions and collect rare drops! Your progress is saved automatically — feel free to leave and return.
inventory_body: Equip better items, sell unwanted drops on the market and unlock new classes as your level rises.
quests_body: Accept quests from NPCs, complete objectives and claim rewards. Chained quests unlock bosses like the Goblin Wizard!
